title: WE J'ouvert 1K & 5K Run/Walk
summary: A family-friendly 1K or 5K run/walk at Queen's Park Savannah with entry from TT$130 and finish-line activities.
description: WE J'ouvert Band is hosting a standalone 1K and 5K run/walk at Queen's Park Savannah on Saturday 24 October 2026. The 1K starts at 3:30 PM and costs TT$130; the 5K starts at 4:30 PM and costs TT$150. Both distances are open to runners and walkers of all paces and ages. The organiser describes the 1K as family-friendly and lists a bouncy castle, face painting, prizes and giveaways. Registration is open. Fees are non-refundable, and missing the advertised bib-collection window forfeits the bib and entry without refund, credit or transfer.
